concerns.text: The plan uses Formation Energy as a proxy for Elastic Modulus. While the substitution is documented, Formation Energy does not directly measure mechanical stiffness, so the dataset is not appropriate for evaluating UQ performance on an elastic‑modulus property. This misalignment may invalidate conclusions about mechanical‑property uncertainty, constituting a methodology issue.
